visualCharacteristics.purpose: grid of key company facts, each a bold label over an icon and a short value

contentPattern.structure: one row per fact: cell 1 label (e.g. Head Office:), cell 2 value text, optionally preceded by an icon (:icon-name: or a small image), either inline or in its own cell before the value

usage: About page facts strip (CEO, head office, team members, partners, offices, established, alliance)
reuseGuidance: Use for short label/value facts or statistics in a grid. For descriptive tiles with a heading, text and link use cards-service.
